approach: Static recompilation with PS2Recomp; PCSX2's GS, microVU and SPU2 as libraries. The game code is translated and compiled on the player's PC from their own disc.
notes: Menus, fights, videos, sound, memory card, keyboard and gamepads at 60 fps, up to 4 players. Works with the Japanese disc and with Lord Izen's English fan translations. Online play for 4 exists, not yet tried between two PCs. Downloads ship no game material: the first run checks your disc image and builds the game code locally.
help: Online play tests between two PCs
